ops.quote: Prevailing deep convolutional neural networks (CNNs) for person re-IDentification (reID) are usually built upon ResNet or VGG backbones
body structural information plays an important role in reID but it is not encoded in backbones
reID is essentially a retrieval task but current NAS algorithms are merely designed for classification
we propose to automatically search for a CNN architecture that is specifically suitable for the reID task
our Auto-ReID enables the automated approach to find an efficient and effective CNN architecture for reID
reID is different from classification, the architecture should be modified accordingly
extensive experiments demonstrate that the searched architecture achieves state-of-the-art performance
we propose a retrieval-based search algorithm over a specifically designed reID search space
no existing NAS methods incorporate the structure information of input images
